items.source: Creation of the lazy target object is controlled by the user by implementing the createObject() method. This TargetSource will invoke this method the first time the proxy is accessed.
items.translation: 懒目标对象的创建由用户通过实现createObject()方法进行控制。该TargetSource将在首次访问代理时调用此方法。

items.source: Subclasses may wish to override this method in order to provide a meaningful value when the target is still null.
items.translation: 子类可能希望重写此方法，以便在目标仍为null时提供一个有意义的值。

items.source:
Useful when you need to pass a reference to some dependency to an object
but you don't actually want the dependency to be created until it is first used.
A typical scenario for this is a connection to a remote resource.
items.translation: 在需要将某个依赖的引用传递给对象，但又不希望该依赖在首次使用前就被创建时非常有用。一个典型的使用场景是连接到远程资源。

items.source:
Returns the lazy-initialized target object,
creating it on-the-fly if it doesn't exist already.
items.translation: 返回延迟初始化的目标对象，如果该对象尚不存在则动态创建。

items.source:
Return whether the lazy target object of this TargetSource
has already been fetched.
items.translation: 返回此 TargetSource 的懒加载目标对象是否已被获取。

items.source:
Subclasses should implement this method to return the lazy initialized object.
Called the first time the proxy is invoked.
items.translation: 子类应实现此方法以返回延迟初始化的对象。代理首次被调用时执行该方法。

items.source: Exception - if creation failed
items.translation: Exception - 如果创建失败

items.source: This default implementation returns null if the target is null (it is hasn't yet been initialized), or the target class if the target has already been initialized.
items.translation: 此默认实现会在目标为null（尚未初始化）时返回null，或在目标已初始化后返回目标类。

items.source: Subclasses should implement this method to return the lazy initialized object.
items.translation: 子类应实现此方法以返回懒初始化对象。
`getTargetClass` 接口 `TargetClassAware` 中
`getTargetClass` 接口 `TargetSource` 中
`getTarget` 接口 `TargetSource` 中

items.source: the type of targets returned by this TargetSource
items.translation: 此 `TargetSource` 返回的目标类型

items.source: Exception - if the target object can't be resolved
items.translation: Exception - 如果无法解析目标对象

items.source: the target object which contains the joinpoint, or null if there is no actual target instance
items.translation: 包含连接点的目标对象，或者如果没有实际的目标实例则为null。
